prerequisites.interpreter: Python 3.12 with the gateway dev dependencies, including pgserver and psycopg2
prerequisites.database: isolated PostgreSQL 16 via the existing pg_url fixture; an existing BG_TEST_POSTGRES_URI is optional
prerequisites.missing_database_or_dependency: test failure, never a skipped or SQLite success
prerequisites.evidence_directory: FLOW_READ_EVIDENCE_DIR points to an existing private directory

commands.fixture_and_semantics: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -o junit_family=legacy tests/orchestration/test_flow_read_performance.py::test_history_scale_regression --junitxml="${FLOW_READ_EVIDENCE_DIR:?set a private evidence directory}/SCN-01.xml"
commands.bounded_query_growth: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -o junit_family=legacy tests/orchestration/test_flow_read_performance.py::test_bounded_history_queries --junitxml="${FLOW_READ_EVIDENCE_DIR:?set a private evidence directory}/AC-01-query-growth.xml"
commands.injected_regression: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -o junit_family=legacy tests/orchestration/test_flow_read_performance.py::test_injected_per_hop_query_regression_fails --junitxml="${FLOW_READ_EVIDENCE_DIR:?set a private evidence directory}/AC-01-injected.xml"

evidence.format: JUnit XML properties fixture_manifest, fixture_source_sha256 and source_revision, plus pytest case outcomes
evidence.fixture_case: SCN-01.xml: test_history_scale_regression passes only with the seeded rows and independent state/cost oracles
evidence.growth_case: AC-01-query-growth.xml: SELECT count at 30 hops must be at most count at 1 hop plus 5
evidence.injected_case: AC-01-injected.xml: 30-hop injected SELECT growth is rejected
evidence.incomplete_if: any selector skips, fails, or lacks its JUnit receipt; a passing fixture case alone does not certify query growth
evidence.source_revision: JUnit XML source_revision property identifies the exact tested commit

prerequisites.target: isolated synthetic fixture, private authorized API/browser configuration and current auth; never production load certification
prerequisites.config: FLOW_READ_PRIVATE_CONFIG names a private JSON file with frontend_url, api_base_url, auth_file, list_flow_ids, graph_flow_id, graph_title, graph_node_ids, graph_node_refs and graph_edges
prerequisites.selection: Optional list_query defaults to fixture-flow; an empty string selects the unfiltered authorized workspace. API and browser both select the first 25-row page. Pin expected identities before the run; empty lists are invalid. Real-workspace comparisons remain distinct from controlled fixture results.
prerequisites.auth_file: private JSON access_token, id_token and future expiry_ms; never include credentials in the manifest or published evidence
prerequisites.results: FLOW_READ_EVIDENCE_DIR names an existing private directory; run-before and run-after do not exist yet
prerequisites.abort: send SIGINT to the owned benchmark process after its ownership.json exists; the command records an incomplete result and drains its browser client

commands.self_test: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -o junit_family=legacy tests/orchestration/test_flow_read_benchmark.py::test_scn_02_abort_rerun_receipts --junitxml="${FLOW_READ_EVIDENCE_DIR:?set a private evidence directory}/SCN-02.xml"
commands.before: .venv/bin/python scripts/benchmark-flow-reads.py --config "${FLOW_READ_PRIVATE_CONFIG:?set private config}" --output "${FLOW_READ_EVIDENCE_DIR:?set a private evidence directory}/run-before"
commands.rerun: .venv/bin/python scripts/benchmark-flow-reads.py --config "${FLOW_READ_PRIVATE_CONFIG:?set private config}" --output "${FLOW_READ_EVIDENCE_DIR:?set a private evidence directory}/run-after" --manifest "${FLOW_READ_EVIDENCE_DIR}/run-before/ownership.json"

frontend_verification.sampler_prerequisites: private FLOW_READ_CONFIG and FLOW_READ_CAPTURE_DIR; launch via benchmark-flow-reads.py to enforce shared caps and protected artifacts

evidence.self_test: SCN-02.xml: interruption, same-manifest new-output rerun, idempotent cleanup and preserved protected results
evidence.before: run-before/evidence.json remains incomplete after abort; api-attempts.jsonl retains completed attempts and ownership.json records reservations
evidence.recovery: run-before/cleanup-receipts.jsonl preserves repeated cleanup attempts; run-after/evidence.json is an independent bounded run
evidence.ownership: ownership.json has run_id, owned_output, owned_workspace, client_pid/client_start, attempt_limit, active_limit_seconds, state and owned_fixtures; only matching owned resources may be cleaned
evidence.cleanup: each cleanup.json has run_id, removed_workspace, client_stopped, owned_fixture_remnants, workspace_remains, failures and complete; a leftover or cleanup failure makes evidence incomplete
evidence.measurement: each evidence.json records source_revision, config_revision, fixture_revision, per-mode API/browser attempts, SQL counts where observed, core HTTP/meaningful/enrichment times and an explicit complete result
evidence.budget: at most 3000 shared API/browser HTTP attempts including warm polls, 20 active minutes, five readers, 15-second request timeout and 30-second browser drain
evidence.incomplete_if: missing or aborted samples, five consecutive failures, exhausted caps, missing cleanup receipts or owned fixture remnants; mock self-tests do not prove live latency
